privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.meta:
Ugam Foj — bus tour booking app
Published by Occubit Solution · Effective 27 May 2026
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Occubit Solution ("we", "us") collects, uses, and shares information when you use the Ugam Foj mobile application (the "App"), which helps travellers request seats on group bus tours and helps tour organisers manage those bookings. By using the App you agree to this Policy.
privacy.s1_provide_b1: Booking details — your name, mobile phone number, the tour you choose, the seat(s) you select, passenger details, boarding point, and any notes you add.
privacy.s1_provide_b2: Organiser account — if you sign in as a tour organiser, your mobile phone number and password.
privacy.s1_contacts:
If you sign in as a tour organiser, and only with your permission, the App reads the names and phone numbers stored in your device's address book and saves them to your organiser account on our servers. This lets you quickly find and select existing contacts when creating and managing bookings.

This contacts sync does not run for travellers who use the App only to request a booking. You can decline the contacts permission, or revoke it later in your device settings, and continue using the rest of the App.
privacy.s1_device_b1: A secure login/session token (kept in your device's encrypted storage).
privacy.s1_device_b2: A local copy of your tours and bookings so the App works offline.
privacy.s1_device_b3: Your language and app preferences, and basic network-connectivity status.
privacy.s1_no_collect: We do not collect your location, photos, or camera data, and the App contains no advertising and no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs.
privacy.s2_b1: To create, send, and manage your bus tour booking requests.
privacy.s2_b2: To let tour organisers contact you about your booking and manage seat assignments.
privacy.s2_b3: To authenticate organiser logins and keep your session secure.
privacy.s2_b4: To operate the App offline and sync your data when you reconnect.
privacy.s3_b1: Contacts — used as described in Section 1, only for organiser accounts, to import names and numbers for booking management.
privacy.s3_b2: Internet & network state — to sync your bookings with our servers and detect whether you are online.
privacy.s4_b1: With your tour organiser. Booking requests you submit are shared with the organiser of that tour so they can confirm and manage your seats.
privacy.s4_b2: Via WhatsApp. When you submit a booking request, the App opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message containing your name, phone number, and booking details so you can send it to the organiser. Your use of WhatsApp is governed by WhatsApp / Meta's own privacy policy.
privacy.s4_b3: Hosting provider (Supabase). We use Supabase to host our database and backend. Your data is processed and stored on their infrastructure on our behalf.
privacy.s4_b4: Legal. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights, users, or the public.
privacy.s4_no_sell: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.s5_body: Your information is stored in our backend database (Supabase) and on your device. We rely on encrypted connections (HTTPS) and the platform's secure storage for session credentials. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your information.
privacy.s6_body: We keep booking and contact information for as long as needed to provide the service and to maintain organisers' booking records. You may request deletion of your personal information at any time (see Section 8), after which we will delete it unless we are required to keep it for legal reasons.
privacy.s7_body: The App is intended for adults arranging group travel and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us information, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.s8_b1: Request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information.
privacy.s8_b2: Withdraw contacts permission at any time in your device settings.
privacy.s8_b3: Ask us questions about how your data is handled.
privacy.s8_body: To exercise any of these, email us at the address below and we will respond within a reasonable time.
privacy.s9_body: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will revise the "Effective" date above and, where appropriate, notify you within the App.
privacy.s10_body:
Questions or requests about this Policy or your data:

Occubit Solution
Email: zeel.shiyani68@gmail.com

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.meta:
Ugam Foj — bus tour booking app
Published by Occubit Solution · Effective 27 May 2026
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Ugam Foj mobile application (the "App"), published by Occubit Solution. By using the App you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.
terms.s1_body: Ugam Foj lets travellers browse published group bus tours and submit a booking request, and lets tour organisers manage tours, buses, seating, and those requests. The App is a coordination tool — it is not a payment processor or a ticketing authority.
terms.s2_body: Submitting a booking request does not guarantee a seat. A booking is only confirmed once the tour organiser accepts your request and assigns seats. Seat availability, pricing, dates, and routes shown in the App are provided by the organiser and may change.
terms.s3_b1: Provide accurate name, phone number, and passenger details when requesting a booking.
terms.s3_b2: Keep your contact number reachable so the organiser can confirm your booking.
terms.s3_b3: Use the App only for lawful, personal travel-booking purposes.
terms.s4_body: The App does not collect payments. Any fares, deposits, or refunds are arranged and settled directly between you and the tour organiser, on the organiser's own terms. Occubit Solution is not a party to that transaction.
terms.s5_body: Cancellation, rescheduling, and refund decisions are made by the tour organiser. You can edit or withdraw a pending request from within the App; once seats are assigned, contact the organiser directly for any changes.
terms.s6_body: Organiser accounts are provisioned by the developer and secured with a phone number and password. Organisers are responsible for keeping their credentials confidential and for the accuracy of the tours and booking information they publish.
terms.s7_b1: Do not submit false, fraudulent, or spam booking requests.
terms.s7_b2: Do not attempt to access accounts or data that are not yours.
terms.s7_b3: Do not interfere with, disrupt, or reverse-engineer the App or its backend.
terms.s8_body: The App is provided "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running but do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation, and we may update, suspend, or discontinue features at any time.
terms.s9_body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Occubit Solution is not liable for the conduct of tour organisers or travellers, for the quality, safety, or completion of any tour, or for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of the App.

about.title: About Ugam Foj
about.intro: Ugam Foj is the bus-booking companion for group pilgrimages and tours organised around Bhedapipaliya Dham (DEVAM). It brings the whole journey — from announcing a tour, to gathering seat requests, to assigning seats and sending tickets over WhatsApp — into one simple app.
about.travellers_body: Browse upcoming tours, see what's available, and request your seats in a few taps. Track every request and its latest status under "My Requests", and pick up your seat details once the organiser confirms them.
about.organisers_body: Publish tours, manage buses and seat layouts, review incoming requests, assign seats, and message travellers — all built to work offline and stay in sync.
about.who_body:
Ugam Foj is published by Occubit Solution.
